candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement zeroing the caller's balance after the payout, so withdraw sends funds but leaves balances[msg.sender] unchanged.
Delete the statement that sets the lock to true on entry, disabling the reentrancy guard so a reentrant withdraw can drain the balance twice.

Delete the statement resetting the lock to false after the function body, so after the first withdraw the lock stays set and every later withdraw reverts (leaving balances unchanged where P would have zeroed them).

Move the balance-zeroing statement before the external call so a reentrant caller observes a zero balance, changing balances visible during nested calls (and enabling different observable outcomes on reentrancy).
Remove the __lock_modifier0 guard from withdraw so reentrancy is no longer prevented.
Move the zeroing of the balance before the external call, so the caller's balance is already zero when receiving ether.
Remove the final reset of the lock so withdraw can never be called a second time (the lock stays set permanently).
